title: Orbit Board v1.0.0 (Matte Orbit Theme & Per-Key Popup)
changelog: Orbit Theme Matte Upgrade: Soft, glare-free Bauhaus matte color tones (Warm Ochre, Carmine Red, Cobalt Slate, Chalk White, Graphite Dark) on pitch AMOLED black
Per-Key Color-Matching Popups: Key press preview bubbles now dynamically match each key's specific color and contrast text/icons
Long-Press Number & Symbol Fix: Seamless input of numbers and symbols across all layouts without swallowing or dropping characters
Zero English Flash & Bengali Multi-candidate engine: Instant phonetic composition with multi-suggestion strip
